entities.summary: John Rodrigues is an Indian prelate of the Catholic Church who is the Archbishop of Bombay. He was coadjutor archbishop of the Archdiocese of Bombay from 30 November 2024 to 25 January 2025. He was Bishop of Poona from March 2023 to November 2024, and before that served as an auxiliary bishop of Bombay for ten years.
